findings.title: Registered metric alert handler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its required abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates the registered handler with `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, so processing any detector whose type is `metric_alert_fire` will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` rather than safely returning no results as before. Either keep this type on a concrete no-op handler until it is implemented, or implement the stateful handler contract.

findings.title: New group-key evaluation test builds the expected occurrence for a different group key
findings.body: `test_dedupe` constructs its expected occurrence with group key `"val1"`, but invokes `evaluate_group_key_value` with `expected_result.group_key`, which is `"group_key"`. The occurrence fingerprint is generated from the group key, so the expected fingerprint is `<detector id>:val1` while the actual occurrence fingerprint is `<detector id>:group_key`; as a result this assertion will fail once `IssueOccurrence` value equality is applied. Build the expected occurrence using `"group_key"`.
